gen-gf-paprika-gf-nobile: Commanding Paprika stretches its lowercase up like capitals, each counter hollow and breathing. Nobile takes over beneath with open mouths and barely any gap between x-height and caps, so a long read stays smooth and contemporary.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-nokora: Nokora reads dark and friendly, a wide s never tightening and the lowercase packing a thick stripe through every line. Yet Paprika above it spreads its letters apart and lets its counters breathe, so the heading feels loud against that dense texture.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Paprika is the showman here, scattering its letters and letting lowercase fill the line like capitals. Noto Kufi Arabic does the quieter job, a modern sans with welcoming c openings and capitals barely above the lowercase.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans lets its lowercase take up most of the letter height, with a wide-open c that keeps lines easy to follow. Paprika above it brings the swagger, so the two split the work cleanly.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Paprika makes its entrance with expressive, widely scattered letters. Noto Sans Adlam follows in a sans with curve endings kept well apart and a tall, full c, s and z, so the heading's drama meets a body that stays open and tidy.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hi: Expressive Paprika lets its lowercase fill the line like capitals, with hollow counters that breathe. But Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs is the better workhorse, a modern sans whose outward-pointing terminals and towering x-height suit sustained text.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Commanding is Paprika's whole manner, its lowercase filling the line like capitals above scattered letters. Noto Sans Arabic holds the text, a clean sans with wide openings on small letters and a pronounced x-height that needs no enlarging.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Noto Sans Armenian brings a professional, approachable body, its c, s and z standing tall and full with wide, inviting round letters. Yet the real draw is the gap between that friendly text and Paprika's commanding, hollow-countered heading.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Expressive Paprika scatters its letters and lets lowercase fill the line like capitals. Yet Noto Sans Avestan keeps a modern, clean sans-serif body underneath, its curve tips never touching, so extended reading feels open and unhurried.
